name: Native AWQ whole-block staging proof checkpoint
body:
Independent native AWQ FP16 adaptation: actual block execution through both staging barriers.

The unchanged full source template is bound in four N64/N128 instances. Lean now proves all 64 combined A-then-B lane executions in actual scheduler order, native wave64 convergence, and the middle block-barrier resumption. Initial execution from PC0 is composed through both barriers in the first K32 chunk, retaining the remaining matrix/K-loop continuation.

All 16x32 shared A cells, including correct row-tail zeros, and all 32xtileN shared B cells equal the dense input coordinates. Earlier lane values survive later lane writes. Inputs, outside memory and accumulators are preserved; epochs receive exactly the existing barrier update. Shared values for every native matrix fragment are identified; scalar fragment loads and MFMA execution remain unproved.

Fresh source checks and a standalone replay without Git or owned compiled caches each pass 418 axiom audits (34 owned modules, 358 library and 60 source audits). Six changed sources fail on false source identity. Thirty-five fully rehashed scope controls fail before extraction. All 32 AWQ Lean resources match the built wheel. The earlier per-lane archive remains readable with its original 363-audit scope and 31 controls. Every new module retains maxRecDepth10000 and maxHeartbeats2000000, and all original machine fuels and shape bounds are unchanged.

The attached source archive is byte-identical to the independently replayed archive. Logs, strict reader, scope controls and numerical evidence are in the repository. No new GPU launches or model calls: the earlier paired AMD study retains 120 launches and 820,224 CPU float64 output comparisons, zero tolerance failures and zero host bit differences.

Scalar matrix loads, native MFMA execution, K-loop induction, output stores, actual whole-trace race freedom and dense-reference equality remain unfinished. AWQ source certificates: 0; accepted independent production families: eight. The paper's exact adapted PTX, original model/token outcomes, NVIDIA measurements and IEEE rounding equivalence are not reproduced. Full repository CI is tracked separately from the completed local checks.
